passages.text: A song of ascents. Of David.
passages.sermon: This is a song.\r\nDavid wrote this song.\r\nPeople sing this song as they go up to worship God.

passages.text: If the LORD had not been on our side— let Israel now declare— if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us, when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive, then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us, then the raging waters would have swept us away.
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents by David.
Israel must say this.
The LORD was on our side.
If the LORD had not been on our side, men would have attacked us.
Their anger burned against us.
They would have swallowed us alive.
Floods would have covered us.
A torrent would have passed over us.
Raging waters would have swept over us.
passages.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ יֹֽאמַר־ נָ֝א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ בְּק֖וּם עָלֵ֣ינוּ אָדָֽם׃ אֲ֭זַי חַיִּ֣ים בְּלָע֑וּנוּ בַּחֲר֖וֹת אַפָּ֣ם בָּֽנוּ׃ אֲ֭זַי הַמַּ֣יִם שְׁטָפ֑וּנוּ נַ֗֜חְלָה עָבַ֥ר עַל־ נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ׃ אֲ֭זַי עָבַ֣ר עַל־ נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ הַ֝מַּ֗יִם הַזֵּֽידוֹנִֽים׃

passages.text: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this song for people going up to worship.
The LORD is God.
The LORD did not let our enemies destroy us.
The LORD did not let us become food for their teeth.
We bless the LORD.
passages.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה שֶׁלֹּ֥א נְתָנָ֥נוּ טֶ֝֗רֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.
passages.sermon:
We are the people of Israel.
We escaped danger.
We escaped like a bird.
A fowler set a snare for us.
The snare broke.
We slipped away safely.
passages.original: נַפְשֵׁ֗נוּ כְּצִפּ֥וֹר נִמְלְטָה֮ מִפַּ֪ח י֫וֹקְשִׁ֥ים הַפַּ֥ח נִשְׁבָּ֗ר וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ נִמְלָֽטְנוּ׃

passages.text: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
passages.sermon: The LORD made heaven and earth.\r\nHe is our helper.\r\nWe call on the name of the LORD for help.
passages.original: עֶ֭זְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
